scope: admin frontend only; no backend, live system, roadmap, or workshop mutation

red.reason: intake API methods and components were absent

claims: Admin navigation exposes a repo-first Intake surface.
List, new submission, and detail views use the versioned catalog-intake API contract.
The pinned Quickstart repository is presented as canonical and required fields as draft hints or overrides.
Draft state, blockers, evidence, supported targets, current seat ceiling, immutable release identity, approvals, and rollback are visible.
The read-only pipeline view exposes submitted and locked stages while keeping every action unavailable.
Process-local and durable PostgreSQL draft storage scopes are rendered from the API response.
Certification and promotion actions remain disabled.
non_claims: No automated repository discovery is implemented by this frontend slice.
No certification, approval, promotion, or execution endpoint is called.
No deployment or live browser certification was performed.
